properties.description: Extends the confirmation ledger (cap:freshness) with the verification side of the same question. Per capability: the newest dated last_run_at across its passing VERIFIES checks, set beside the dates the ledger already computes for baseline accepts on its realizing artifacts — so a reader can see that a capability is claiming `verified` on a check that predates the code it covers. A SIGNAL, NOT A GAP, deliberately (dec:verification-freshness-not-a-gap): it is a standing property of the claim rather than an event, it fires on every legitimate refactor as readily as on a real hole, and a list that can never reach zero gets skimmed — which is the failure the whole gap workflow exists to prevent. THREE CONSTRAINTS THE CORE ALREADY IMPOSES AND THIS MUST HONOUR: the core takes no clock, so this compares recorded timestamps supplied by callers and never asks the system what time it is; undated events are not comparable, which the ledger already states; and where either side is undated the answer is an explicit `unknown` that is REPORTED, never a silent pass — an unanswerable freshness question presented as freshness is the same lie in a new place.
properties.name: Say whether a check is older than what it checks
